headword: {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}

definitions.gloss: health promotion; health improvement; enhancing one's health
definitions.explanation: The active pursuit of better health through exercise, diet, lifestyle changes, or public health policies. Used both for individual efforts and government or organizational initiatives.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started jogging to improve my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}している→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。
examples.english: The city is implementing a health promotion program.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧、⟦{受動|じゅどう}→受動：12070_judou⟧⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Based on the Health Promotion Act, measures against secondhand smoke were strengthened.

notes:
A four-character compound commonly seen in government policy, public health campaigns, and everyday conversation about healthy living. Japan's {健康|けんこう}{増進|ぞうしん}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (Health Promotion Act) is a well-known piece of legislation.
